PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

layouts, and out-of-home campaigns. Comfortable owning a brief from

a senior designer position at a brand studio.

SKILLS

- Tools: vector illustration suites, photo retouching, prepress software
- Print: colour separation, paper selection, press checks, die cutting
- Direction: moodboards, shoot supervision, stylist coordination
- Client: pitch decks, brand guideline documents, vendor briefs
